output.brief: The crash gap is mostly not caused by the Tiled Canvas flag. Only 7.4.0 users can have the flag, and 7.4.0 crashes about 2% of sessions versus 0.7% on 7.3.2. That was true from 2 Sep, before any flag ramp. Within 7.4.0, flag-on users crash 2.10% and the random flag-off holdout 1.98%. The difference is 0.12 points and is within noise. The largest crash cluster, 41% of events, is a native crash in the upgraded Pixelda image library decoding HEIF images, and it does not occur in 7.3.2. The app store's separate crash counts agree, so this is not a reporting artifact. Device mix and usage are the same across groups, and the sync-service deploy shows no effect on 7.3.2. Don't turn the flag off and push 7.4.0 to 100%, because that would ship the real defect to everyone. Hold the rollout at 25%, ship a fix for the Pixelda crash, and keep the existing holdout running to see whether the flag adds a small effect of a few tenths of a point. Confidence is fairly high on the main conclusion. It is lower on whether the flag has a small effect.
